question: Appendicitis, EXCEPT (repeat open vs laparoscopic in females)
question_ar: جميع الجمل المتعلقة بالتهاب الزائدة الدودية صحيحة باستثناء؟

options.text: Psoas sign is elicited by extension of the right hip
Rovsing sign is elicited by pressing in the left iliac fossa causing pain in the right iliac fossa
Pain is less after laparoscopic compared with open appendectomy
Wound infection is less after laparoscopic compared open appendectomy
In female patients, the open approach is preferred over the laparoscopic appendectomy

correct_text: In female patients, the open approach is preferred over the laparoscopic appendectomy
